name: Print Z In Java
html:
Welcome Back Readers!

We hope that your journey so far has been awesome. Moving on, in this article we will discuss about the next problem i.e. "Print Z"


Important Links : Problem Link, Question Video , Solution Video

Problem Discussion :

You are required to print a "z" of size 5 using "*".

For example:

Sample Input:

There is no input

Sample Output:

*****
*
*
*
*****


For more clarity of the question, watch the question video.

Watch video Approach :

The procedure here is very simple and easy to understand.

We have to print a z having a size of 5

System.out.print() prints contents in the same line. For instance,

System.out.print("*");

System.out.print("*");

Would print the 2 stars in the same line as **.


System.out.println() would print the contents and an extra enter at the end. For instance,

System.out.print("I am the First Line");

System.out.print("I am the Second Line");

Would print the 2 strings as : I am the First Line

I am the Second Line

Since we need different rows of stars, we use System.out.println().


The procedure here is very simple and easy to understand.

We have to print a "Z" consisting of 5 rows.

The first and last row of the figure contain the maximum numbers of stars( 5 ) and the other rows consist of some initial spaces followed by a star.

We simply make use of our printing statement ( System.out.println).

import java.util.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { System.out.print("*****"); System.out.print(" *"); System.out.print(" *"); System.out.print(" *"); System.out.print("*****"); } }
java; true";
